description: Exact elasticity reference cases of the ACME manuscript. Beams: simply supported (diaphragm) ends, harmonic m = flexural mode number; plates: simply supported square plates, mode (m, n). Units are those of the laminate definitions (SI, or nondimensional E2 = rho = h = 1, or GPa with kg/m^3 for P-L2); every normalisation uses the same units.
